explanation.summary: SORTLAND IDRETTS OG FRITIDSPARK AS (982 201 640), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2000-04-13; address Kong Øysteinsvei, 8400 SORTLAND, Norge. Main industry is 68.120 Utvikling og salg av byggeprosjekter; 5 registered employees; 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Ingar Angell Nicolaysen; Board chair: Tage Særvold Ellingsen. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 5.17 m, operating profit NOK 561.21 k, net profit NOK 558.72 k, equity NOK 814.69 k, total assets NOK 1.22 m. Website https://www.blabyhallen.no shows the registered name.
